description: Acknowledgment for user moves that match the engine with cp_loss == 0 and no higher-priority celebratory rule fired. Sub-1400 players need positive reinforcement AND a reason when one is unambiguous (Parth fb_ba9db31ae393: 'Best move. but why?'). good_move_reason is stamped by inject_good_move_reason_facts ONLY when the why is deterministically safe; otherwise it stays unset and we fall back to the terse default — never an invented reason.

fact_glossary.good_move_reason: capture | central_break | develop | (unset). Set by inject_good_move_reason_facts.
fact_glossary.good_move_captured_square: square of the capture, when good_move_reason == capture

variants.central_break: {played_san} — fights for the center. Control the center and your pieces get the best squares.
variants.develop: {played_san} — develops a piece. Get every piece into the game before you attack.
